candidates.dataset_title: Kenya Continuous Household Survey Programme 2020 Quarters 1 and 2 - Crop Output Data
candidates.target_role: none; may inform market-output or crop-sales research only
blocking_gaps: The published Crop Output file records crop sales, not total crop production.
The published file has no harvested area field, so a defensible yield label cannot be derived.
The survey is a household sample, not an official county-season crop statistics panel.
candidates.next_action: Do not build a yield adapter. Retain only as a possible future market-intelligence source.

candidates.dataset_title: Kenya Integrated Household Budget Survey 2005-2006 - Agriculture Holding and Agriculture Output
candidates.target_role: historical microdata experiment for linkage and unit-reconciliation research
candidates.geographic_resolution: household and parcel records; representative at national, urban/rural, provincial, and district levels
candidates.temporal_coverage: 2005-2006 survey with a 12-month agriculture reference period
blocking_gaps: The data are from 2005-2006 and cannot validate a current mid-season forecasting product.
The survey is not a county-season official yield panel and its published representativeness is district-level rather than current county boundaries.
Parcel-to-crop linkage, maize-code aggregation, harvested-unit conversion, survey weights, anonymization, and access conditions require validation before use.
Household microdata cannot silently replace the feasibility-selected county statistics target.
candidates.next_action: Use only for a separately approved research notebook after access, linkage, unit, weighting, and licensing review.
